# Create the requested per-task program, encoding the general masked periodic-row completion used in the demos.
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4f10839e.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Complete zero gaps in rows by extending the local horizontal periodic sequence.
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    for r in range(h):
        known=[c for c,v in enumerate(g[r]) if v in (1,2,3,5,7,9)]
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=0: continue
            left=[x for x in known if x<c]; right=[x for x in known if x>c]
            if left and right and c-left[-1] <= 10 and right[0]-c <= 10:
                a=left[-1]; g[r][c]=g[r][a] # placeholder replaced by periodic continuation below
                seq=[1,3,5,7,9]
                # infer +2 sequence where adjacent nonzero entries establish it
                if a+1<len(g[r]) and g[r][a+1] in seq:
                    step=(seq.index(g[r][a+1])-seq.index(g[r][a]))%5
                else: step=1
                g[r][c]=seq[(seq.index(g[r][a])+step*(c-a))%5]
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code); print(p)
